\paragraph{Metrics of Table~\ref{tab:extended-id}.}\label{app:extended-id-metrics}
Linear AUC is an L2 logistic-regression probe for the confounder on the held-out documents (5 audit folds, $C$ chosen on an inner split; one-vs-rest macro ROC-AUC when $C>2$; unflipped). MLP AUC is a standardised MLP (256, 128) probe on the same folds. For R@1 and R@10, each held-out pair queries the whole transformed corpus in both directions, excluding the query and, in three-class settings, its other linked counterpart; recall is averaged over all held-out pairs. In the supplementary rows, SemEval graded similarity is Spearman's $\rho$ between held-out pair cosines and the negated Overall rating (higher = more similar; the ratings are almost all 1 or 2), one value per seed over the held-out pairs of all five outer folds; CAP topic ARI is the adjusted Rand index between a 21-cluster $k$-means of the held-out documents and the gold topics; both use 5 seeds (0--4).
